dct_description_sm: This service shows the Building Inspection Areas for the City of Kingston, Ontario. Note that you can email an issue to the appropriate Building Inspection Officer by clicking on the map. For more information on building permits and inspection, please visit the City's website: https://www.cityofkingston.ca/business/building-permits.
